# A splitter's drag opens a sort session in its parent dashboard

## Context

This surfaced while measuring #20585 (the Pointer Events sensor) on the component tier. The `DockSplitterIframePane` page left its `dashboard.Container` stamped `neo-is-dragging` after a splitter drag. @neo-gemini-maryam traced the mechanism in the Depth Floor of review 5817047622 on #20585.

Reproduced on `dev` @ `22f79ac1e9` with a new component arm (`test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterSortZone.spec.mjs`), 3/3 red:

```
Error: the dashboard opens no sort session during a splitter drag
Expected: false
Received: true
```

A probe on the same arm read the stamp every 250 ms after release. It was still present 15 s later in 3/3 runs.

## The Problem

Every `Neo.component.Splitter` carries `neo-draggable` in its `baseCls` (`src/component/Splitter.mjs:40`; `DockSplitter` at `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/DockSplitter.mjs:72`). A `dashboard.Container` is `dragResortable: true` by default, and its SortZone listens for `drag:start` / `drag:move` / `drag:end` on the delegate `.neo-draggable` (`src/draggable/container/DragZone.mjs:30-37`).

The splitter registers its own `drag:start` / `drag:end` listeners without `bubble: false` (`src/component/Splitter.mjs:94-97`). So `DomEvent#fire` (`src/manager/DomEvent.mjs:180-255`) carries the splitter's `drag:start` up the component path to the dashboard. `SortZone#onDragStart` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:881`) finds the splitter among `getSortableItems()`, because the generic `isDraggableItem` admits every component item, and opens a sort session for it: proxy, placeholder, and the `neo-is-dragging` stamp (`src/draggable/DragZone.mjs:553`). The main thread routes the gesture to the splitter's own DragZone, so the dashboard's session never reaches a terminal that clears the stamp.

The visible result: `body:has(.neo-is-dragging) * { pointer-events: none !important }` (`resources/scss/src/draggable/DragProxyComponent.scss`) stays active, and the page stops taking pointer input after one splitter drag.

**Reach.** No app or example in this repository puts a splitter directly inside a `dashboard.Container`. The dock's `LayoutAdapter` places its splitters in plain `container`s (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/LayoutAdapter.mjs:663-668`, `957-977`, `1157`). Any consumer who puts a splitter in a sortable dashboard hits the defect, and the `DockSplitterIframePane` component page is built that way.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: the `DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs` header records the contract: "a splitter resize opens no session at all".
- `DomEvent#fire` ends the path walk once a listener declares `bubble: false` (`src/manager/DomEvent.mjs:228-229`, `252`). That is the engine's existing way for a component to own an event; `MonthYearSelector`, `DateSelector`, `Circle`, `Gallery` and `Helix` use it.
- The SortZone already handles the no-session case. `onDragMove` returns without `itemRects` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:737`; dashboard override `src/draggable/dashboard/SortZone.mjs:434`), and `processDragEnd` returns without `dragComponent` (`:586`). So `drag:move`, which keeps bubbling, stays a no-op on the parent.
- No listener in `src/`, `apps/` or `examples/` relies on a splitter's `drag:start` / `drag:end` reaching an ancestor. Grep receipt: the eight `drag:start` / `drag:end` registrants in `src/` are all their own drag sources, and none exist in `apps/` or `examples/`.

## The Fix

In `src/component/Splitter.mjs` `construct()`, register the splitter's `drag:start` and `drag:end` listeners with `bubble: false`. The splitter is the innermost drag source and owns its gesture, so no ancestor delegate (a SortZone, a Resizable, a dialog header) reacts to it. `DockSplitter` inherits the change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterSortZone.spec.mjs`: during a held splitter drag inside a `dashboard.Container`, the dashboard carries no `neo-is-dragging`, and after release neither `neo-drag-active` nor the stamp remains. Red on `dev` `22f79ac1e9` (3/3), green with the fix.
- [ ] AC-2: The existing splitter suites stay green: `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitter*.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/component/Splitter.spec.mjs`, plus the full unit tier.
- [ ] AC-3: The Workstation splitter e2e specs stay green locally: `DockSplitterZoneIdNL`, `WorkstationEdgeSplitterNL`, `WorkstationSplitterGridGeometryNL`, `WorkstationDragTextSelectionNL`.

## Out of Scope

- A general "the innermost drag source owns the gesture" rule in `DomEvent` for every nested drag source. That is a wider engine decision. This ticket fixes the splitter, whose gesture is never content to sort.

## Avoided Traps

- **Excluding splitters in `container.DragZone#isDraggableItem`** (the other option in the trace). It would hard-code one component type into the generic container contract and change the sort index map of containers that hold splitters between sortable items. The bubbling `drag:end` would also still reach every ancestor.
- **Clearing `neo-is-dragging` on release.** As #17883's traps put it, a stuck class is a symptom; clearing it would hide a session that should never have opened.
